metadata.purpose: Automated FEED-level selection, preliminary sizing, installed-weight estimation, procurement-quantity estimation, and cost estimation for vertical-vessel skirts and horizontal-vessel saddles.
metadata.calculation_philosophy: Use governing empty, operating, hydrotest, wind, seismic, and thermal load cases to create preliminary support geometry. Calculate net steel weight from geometry, iterate support self-weight, and then calculate procurement quantities and FEED cost.

primary_document.source_role: Defines applicable vessel loadings and recognizes vessel supports. It does not provide a complete universal skirt or saddle design method.

skirt.basis: Thin circular-shell membrane stress plus conservative FEED buckling and base-ring screening.

saddle.basis: Statics, geometry-based steel take-off, bearing screening, and configurable local-shell heuristic.

code_basis.source_control_rule: All material allowables, wind and seismic loads, concrete bearing limits, anchor-bolt allowables, and cost rates shall come from a controlled project data source.

custom_functions.round_up_to_series: Return the first ascending candidate value greater than or equal to the required value.
custom_functions.safe_divide: Return null and raise an error when denominator is zero or nonpositive.

fixed_mass_excluding_support_kg.description: Pressure parts, nozzles, internals, lining, insulation, platforms, ladders, and permanent attachments included in the applicable load case.

fixed_mass_cg_x_mm.description: Measured from the left tangent line.

formulas.operating_mass_excluding_support_kg: vessel.fixed_mass_excluding_support_kg + operating_liquid_mass_kg + sum(additional_mass_items.mass_kg where include_operating == true)
formulas.hydrotest_mass_excluding_support_kg: vessel.fixed_mass_excluding_support_kg + hydrotest_water_mass_kg + sum(additional_mass_items.mass_kg where include_hydrotest == true)

derived_allowables.buckling_allowable_mpa: min(feed_tensile_allowable_mpa, defaults.buckling_knockdown_coefficient * materials.support_modulus_mpa * (t_effective_mm / skirt_mean_diameter_mm) * min(1, sqrt(skirt_mean_diameter_mm / skirt_height_mm)))

thickness_iteration.acceptance_rule: For every load case: tensile_utilization <= project.maximum_target_utilization AND compressive_material_utilization <= project.maximum_target_utilization AND buckling_utilization <= project.maximum_target_utilization.
thickness_iteration.selection_rule: Select the first ascending candidate that passes all load cases.

anchor_selection.selection_rule: Select the lowest anchor count and smallest diameter combination for which required_tension_per_active_bolt_n <= allowable_tension_per_bolt_n and circumferential spacing <= defaults.anchor_max_circumferential_spacing_mm.

access_opening_logic.activation: defaults.automatic_access_opening.enabled AND defaults.automatic_access_opening.condition AND no user-defined skirt opening exists

component_formulas.top_ring_mass_kg: top_ring_mass_kg if optional_top_ring_logic is active else 0

saddle_location_logic.preferred_input: User-defined left and right saddle center positions measured from the left tangent line.

cg_and_reaction_engine.case_cg_formula: sum(item_mass_kg * item_cg_x_mm for active items including contents and support self-weight) / total_case_mass_kg

local_shell_heuristic.iteration_rule: Increase saddle_axial_width_mm in 50 mm steps until local_shell_index <= defaults.local_shell_target_index or saddle_axial_width_mm reaches 0.40 * vessel.outer_diameter_mm.
local_shell_heuristic.blocking_rule: If local_shell_index > defaults.local_shell_blocking_index after iteration, return saddle_local_shell_screen_failed.
local_shell_heuristic.note: This is a FEED sizing heuristic. It does not replace complete local shell stress analysis.

algorithm: Build empty, operating, and hydrotest masses and the six environmental load cases.
Route to the skirt or saddle module.
Generate preliminary geometry and calculate new_support_installed_mass_kg.
Rebuild all masses and reactions using the new support mass.
Repeat until relative mass change is not greater than project.self_weight_convergence_tolerance.

formulas.direct_cost: material_cost + fabrication_cost + coating_cost + nde_cost + anchor_bolt_cost + sliding_bearing_cost

validation_rules.condition: all six load cases are defined
selected support thickness exists in controlled commercial thickness series
commercial rates include effective date and fabrication location
installed_support_mass_kg is not increased by procurement wastage
result is marked FEED only and engineering review required

unsupported_orientation.message: Only vertical skirt support and horizontal two-saddle support are enabled.

invalid_vessel_geometry.message: Enter positive vessel diameter and shell thickness.

support_material_properties_missing.message: Controlled support material allowable stress, yield strength, and modulus are required.

support_allowable_exceeds_yield.message: Support allowable stress cannot exceed yield strength.

environmental_load_cases_incomplete.message: Empty, operating, and hydrotest wind and seismic loads are required.

skirt_thickness_not_resolved.message: No candidate skirt thickness passes the FEED material and buckling screens.

anchor_configuration_not_resolved.message: No available anchor count and diameter combination passes the FEED uplift screen.

base_ring_bearing_not_resolved.message: The generated base-ring area does not satisfy the project concrete bearing limit.

base_ring_projection_above_FEED_range.message: The required base-ring projection is outside the default FEED range.

saddle_uplift_requires_engineering_revie.message: A saddle reaction became negative. Restraint and uplift design require engineering review.

saddle_local_shell_screen_failed.message: The saddle local-shell FEED heuristic remains above its blocking limit.

large_saddle_reaction_requires_detailed_.message: The governing saddle reaction exceeds 1,500 kN.

thin_shell_high_D_over_t_requires_detail.message: The vessel shell has a high diameter-to-thickness ratio.

support_self_weight_iteration_not_conver.message: Support self-weight did not converge within the permitted iterations.

cost_rate_traceability_incomplete.message: Cost rates require source, location, currency, and effective date.

procurement_wastage_incorrectly_added_to.message: Procurement wastage affects cost quantity only and shall not be added to installed vessel weight.

final_design_claim_prohibited.message: This result is a FEED estimate and cannot be represented as final support design approval.

implementation_sequence: Route vertical vessels to the skirt module and horizontal vessels to the two-saddle module.
Calculate empty, operating, and hydrotest masses excluding support.
Start self-weight iteration with zero support mass.
Generate support geometry from the governing load cases.
Calculate installed and procurement weights separately.
Repeat the mass and reaction calculation until support mass converges.
Calculate paint area and weld length.
Calculate data quality, uncertainty, and total FEED cost.
Return engineering warnings and retain engineering-review status.
